title: Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting decision (MPM Dec 17-18)
source: NEWS: boj.or.jp 'Monetary Policy Meetings' schedule page (en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/), fetched raw (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and column-parsed out of the HTML table direct 2026-09-05. The table's columns are 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', and the December 2026 row reads 'Dec. 17 (Thurs.), 18 (Fri.)' with '-' in the Outlook column, 'Dec. 28 (Mon.)' for the Summary of Opinions and 'Jan. 27 (Wed.), 2027' for the Minutes; the decision publishes at the meeting's conclusion on the second day. NOT an Outlook Report meeting, unlike October. Filed estimate on two counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for any other central bank, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Understating the label only widens caution.
notes: Proposed during the boj-decision-2026-10-30 initial research (2026-09-05) as the next venue after that decision, and the meeting the surveyed consensus most often names for a further hike if October holds. Reuters' Aug 17-24 2026 poll (published 2026-08-26, 58 economists, press-cited) found 'a minority, 10 of 58, expected it to follow with another hike to 1.5% in either October or December' — this is the December half of that ~17%. AMENDED 2026-09-05 BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH: that ~17% figure is stale by seven days and should not be used to price this meeting on its own. Two dated 2026-09-02 sources postdate it and both cut toward speed — board member Takata Hajime's Sapporo speech, published by the BoJ (boj.or.jp/en/about/press/koen_2026/data/ko260902a1.pdf, fetched and text-extracted 2026-09-05): 'I believe, however, that 2026 represents a regime change where rate hikes will not be carried out at a fixed pace but will instead be conducted in a nimble and data-dependent manner'; and Reuters the same day, sourced, that the BoJ 'is considering hiking more aggressively thereafter than the current pace of roughly two times a year' — where 'thereafter' has only two 2026 venues, 10-29/30 and this one. Two further dated surveys frame the level and the pace: 86% expect 1.25% by end-Q4 (Reuters poll, FXStreet syndication, 2026-07-23) and 82% expect a roughly six-month cadence (Bloomberg survey, Japan Times, 2026-07-23) — which, applied to June's 06-16 hike, lands the next move on mid-December. The same Bloomberg survey had December as the modal timing (50% of 52, vs 40% for October) before August repriced the hike into September, and found 59% calling PM Takaichi's government 'a deterrence for the board to proceed along the path toward policy normalization' — the counterweight, and it binds harder at this horizon than at September's. Net: this meeting's odds move INVERSELY to the 09-18 and 10-30 outcomes, because the 86% end-Q4 level commitment has to be delivered somewhere. See docs/research/events/boj-decision-2026-12-18.md. SAME CHANNEL, SAME CAVEAT AS THE SEPTEMBER AND OCTOBER ENTRIES: a BoJ move propagates to this calendar's long-duration AI names through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledger; symbols is empty and no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed. Policy rate is 1.0% as of the 2026-07-31 statement (8-1, Takata dissenting for 1.25%) — see boj-decision-2026-09-18.json for the primary citation. IMPACT IS MEDIUM for the same reason as the sibling BoJ entries. The decision announcement lands overnight ET and reaches the US tape as a 12-18 open. Date is the JST decision date, matching how the BoJ publishes it. THE PLACEMENT WARNING CARRIES OVER FROM SEPTEMBER, NOT OCTOBER: 12-18 is quarterly opex (see opex-2026-12-18.json), so this decision hits the US tape in the same thirty minutes as a triple-witching SET settlement — the exact confound the boj-decision-2026-09-18 ledger banked its attribution discipline for. Adjacent on this calendar: ecb-decision-2026-12-17 the day before and opex-2026-12-18 the same session. ADJACENCY MEASURED 2026-09-05 (event-material-decide.mjs's own ±5-day window, against the live calendar plus earnings-calendar.ts): 10 tracked events — g20-miami-2026-12-14, pjm-capacity-auction-2026-12, ppi-2026-12-15, retail-sales-2026-12-16, ecb-decision-2026-12-17, import-export-prices-2026-12-17, puct-batch-zero-report-open-meeting-2026-12-17, opex-2026-12-18, durable-goods-2026-12-23, pce-2026-12-23 — the LEAST crowded of the three 2026 BoJ dates (vs 28 for 10-30 and 14 for 09-18), with NO earnings print anywhere between 2026-11-10 and year-end. The confound is concentrated rather than piled up: the triple witching on the same session, plus fomc-2026-12-09 with the dot plot nine days earlier (confirmed, outside the ±5 window but inside any honest macro read). This meeting's Summary of Opinions is 2026-12-28 and its Minutes 2027-01-27; the next MPM is 2027-01-21/22, an Outlook meeting, proposed as boj-decision-2027-01-22.json in the same PR.
